Name: Villager Photos
Author: PinkStations
Description:
[size=2][size=4][b]~Villager Photos[/b]~[/size]
I've always been an avid fan of ACNH and loved collecting my villagers cute little photos. Well I thought it would be fun to do that in Stardew Valley too, so I made this mod!

When you reach 8 hearts with a marriageable villager or 10 hearts for non-marriageable villagers, They will send you a letter expressing their appreciation for you and giving you a photo of themselves! you can do whatever you like with this photo. Do you want to put it next to your bed and sleep next to them at night? Make a shrine showing your devotion? Rank your favorites and display it on your farm? Hoard them in a chest until you've collected them all? The choice is yours!

Every photo has 4 colored frames available for them! You will need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿ to change the colors. I'm open to making more colors if anyone has suggestions!

*Notes*
~ if you load this mod into a previous save where you've met the friendship requirements for villagers, you're gonna have a [i]lot[/i] of mail the next day. Have fun!
~ The photos are technically a craftable item, but there is no recipe available to make them. That being said you cannot hang them on walls or put them on-top of anything. I don't think I will be making them into furniture here as they wont be able to be sent in the mail or locked behind a friendship requirement. But if enough people want them as hang-able photos despite that I would be open to doing it in a separate upload!
~ If you download this mod and collect some photos, then decide to remove it, all of your photos and mail from this mod will be gone. If you add this mod back in again [i]after [/i]saving without it, the mail will return in your collections tab but the photos will not!! At that point the only way to get back the already collected photos in that save would be to download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJBItemSpawner[/url]﻿ and get them back through there.
